title: TALOS Hardware Matrix Certification Schema
description: JSON Schema draft 2020-12 defining the hardware certification matrix for TALOS / LibreMobile OS.

model.description: Commercial model name or hardware codename.

soc.description: System on Chip identifier and architecture.

bootloader_unlock.description: Whether the device bootloader can be unlocked without manufacturer authorization.

bootloader_relock.description: Whether the bootloader can be re-locked with custom user-enrolled root-of-trust keys.

kill_switches.description: Hardware physical cut-off switches for sensitive peripherals.

mic.description: Physical hardware cut-off switch for microphone circuit.

camera.description: Physical hardware cut-off switch for camera sensors.

radio.description: Physical hardware cut-off switch for cellular/Wi-Fi/Bluetooth RF radios.

modem_firmware_status.description: Firmware audit status of the cellular baseband modem.

wifi_bt_firmware_status.description: Firmware audit status of the Wi-Fi and Bluetooth controllers.

gpu_firmware_status.description: Firmware audit status of the graphics processing unit.

camera_firmware_status.description: Firmware audit status of the image signal processor (ISP) and camera subsystem.

blob_inventory.description: Inventory of closed-source blobs required for device boot or functionality.

component.description: Subsystem component name or firmware binary.

source.description: Origin repository, vendor partition, or package source.

source_url.description: Canonical URI for the firmware binary or vendor driver.

verified.description: Whether firmware provenance has been independently verified by the operator.

replaceable_by_librephone.description: Whether Librephone / community reverse-engineering can replace this blob.

treble_compatible.description: Whether the device supports Project Treble GSI system.img replacement.

talos_support_level.description: Formal TALOS support tier: Tier A (Fully Free), Tier B (Blob-Reduced), Tier C (Treble-Compatible), or Roadmap.

notes.description: Operational notes, verified quirks, or TODO(operator) items.
